evals.prompt: Write an epic for Checkout Foundation that serves the Activate buyers outcome in the Alpha phase.
evals.expected_output: A draft epic with title, outcome, phase, priority, estimate, scope, non-goals, and success signal — no story Gherkin. Offers backlog.md upsert and/or tracker create after confirmation.
assertions: Draft includes outcome, phase, priority, estimate, scope, and non-goals
Does not put story-level Gherkin on the epic
Traces the epic to a product outcome
Does not write a full multi-epic backlog decomposition
Waits for confirmation before applying unless create/write was explicit

evals.prompt: Add this epic to our markdown backlog as CHK02.
evals.expected_output: Reads backlog.md to avoid ID collisions, upserts the epic row, optionally writes specs/{work-short-name}/epic.md, reports path and ID.
assertions: Reads backlog.md before assigning or confirming an internal ID
Upserts docs/product/backlog.md when applying to filesystem
Uses a work path slug of at most two words
Does not invent a tracker key for filesystem-only work

evals.prompt: Create an epic in Linear under the Activation initiative.
evals.expected_output: Resolves Linear, drafts portable epic fields, creates/updates the epic with parent linkage when modelled, reports the Linear key — no parallel internal ID.
assertions: Resolves Linear as destination (or asks if ambiguous with Jira)
Uses the tracker key as canonical ID
Does not write a shadow backlog.md for a tracker-backed repo
Links or names the parent initiative when available
